x86_vaddps_zmm.description: Performs element-wise addition of 16 single-precision (32-bit) floating-point numbers from zmm2 and zmm3/m512, storing the result in zmm1 with optional masking and zeroing.
x86_vaddps_zmm.source_db: Intel Architecture Instruction Set Extensions Reference

arm64_fadd_vec.description: Adds corresponding single-precision floating-point elements in the four 32-bit lanes of vectors v1 and v2, and places the results in vector v0.

rv_vadd_vv.description: Performs element-wise addition of active elements in vector register vs2 and vs1 under mask vm, writing elements to destination vector vd.

armv7_add_r.description: Adds the value of register Rm to Rn, storing the 32-bit result in Rd. If the S suffix is used, condition flags (N, Z, C, V) in APSR are updated.
armv7_add_r.affected_flags: APSR (N, Z, C, V if S suffix set)

rv_jalr.description: Sets the target address to (rs1 + sign-extended 12-bit offset) with lowest bit cleared to zero. Stores the address of instruction following jump (PC + 4) into destination register rd.
